name: Brindle Broadband

ring.prompt: Thanks for calling Brindle Broadband. We record calls for training and quality. You're in a queue and we'll answer as soon as we can.

menu.prompt: If your broadband is down, press one. For account and billing, press two. To give notice on a contract, press three. For bereavement support, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: That's not one I recognise, sorry. Have another go.

holdAnnouncement: Sorry for the wait — we're a small team, and we will get to you.

clerk.greeting: Hello there, Niamh speaking on the customer care desk. I believe you're calling about a bereavement — I'm so sorry. Could I take the account holder's full name?

turns.reprompt: No bother — just the full name on the account, when you're ready.

turns.say: Thank you. And when did they pass away?
turns.reprompt: Sorry, could I have the date again? No rush at all.

documents: no documents needed to close the line; a death certificate copy only if a refund is due to the estate
outcome.closing: I've ended the contract with no early-exit fee, and the router doesn't need to come back to us. Your reference is {REF}. Look after yourself.

quirk: Waives the early-exit fee and doesn't ask for the equipment back.
